faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Madurai Kamaraj University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Madurai Kamaraj University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Madurai Kamaraj University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Dr. P. Varalakshmi, Principal Investigator – MOES Project, Department of Molecular Microbiology, School of Biotechnology, Madurai Kamaraj University, Madurai - 625021, by by post, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Microbiology, or Biochemistry with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA and DA will be paid for attending the interview. Dispersal of the fellowship is contingent on the release of the grant from MoES.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written test. Personal interview. Document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration is 10 months. Engagement is purely on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Madurai.
